headline: Approved Standing Stone Wines liquor license at 111 Winooski Falls Way on a 4-0 vote.
summary: The meeting covered one item, a liquor license for Standing Stone Wines at 111 Winooski Falls Way. The City Clerk said the council had already approved the license and that this step was a formality. The motion to approve passed 4-0.
decisions: Approved the application for Standing Stone Wines' liquor license at 111 Winooski Falls Way, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve the application made by Councilor Turkos and seconded by Councilor Goodrich. Motion passed 4-0.
